snippet.title: Heroes Against Time - New Roguelite Announcement Trailer! (2025)
snippet.description:
Announcing "Heroes Against Time"! A pixel art roguelite where you draft allies, power up and try to avoid the inevitable creeping fog!

Wishlist it here https://s.team/a/3667720 to be notified when the demo goes live!

...

(Also don't worry, I'm still working on Netherguild)

Music is Heroic Age by Kevin MacLeod

Follow our Heroes' journey!
